rv.q: " I’ll admit that, perhaps because of the Olivier’s treacherous acoustics, I wasn’t able to catch every syllable of the quicksilver lyrics. If I’m being ultra-critical, I’d add that the mechanised mice were a tad slow. But don’t be put off: this is a stunning achievement.
Whilst the production is impressive, it currently lacks a rousing Act One number that would propel the musical to near perfection.

cn.t: A stunning achievement with terrific songs that boldly tackles dark themes, though it lacks a rousing Act One showstopper and suffers from occasional acoustic issues.
